abstract: BACKGROUND: The rarity of testis tumor in black patients has made the study of a large series difficult. Much of the epidemiologic and clinical information regarding this neoplasm in this population is in dispute, including data on incidence, prognosis, histologic distribution, age and stage at presentation, and side distribution. METHODS: A retrospective review of 66 blacks with testicular tumors from seven military medical centers was performed. RESULTS: Similar results were found for blacks with testis tumor to those of the general testis cancer population regarding prognosis, side distribution, and age of onset for nonseminoma and interstitial tumors. There is a slight increase in the expected number of interstitial tumors in blacks, but the distribution between seminoma and nonseminoma is similar to the general population. The mean age of presentation for seminoma in blacks was younger than that of the general testis cancer population. For testis tumor treated at the same institution, there was an increased delay of diagnosis in blacks compared with whites. The number of new cases of testicular cancer between 1979 and 1991 at one major center was increased for whites but not for blacks. The availability of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy has resulted in an improved prognosis for blacks, as has already been demonstrated for white populations. CONCLUSIONS: Testis tumor in blacks behaves similarly to testis tumor in the general population except that in blacks there are more interstitial tumors and the mean age of presentation for seminoma is younger. Further, there is an increased delay in diagnosis for blacks compared with whites, but the incidence of this tumor in this population does not appear to be increasing. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy has significantly improved survival in this population.
abstract_ja: 背景：黒人の精巣腫瘍の症例は稀であるため、大規模な症例検討は困難である。黒人の精巣腫瘍について、発生率、予後、組織型分布、診断時の年齢と病期、左右差など、疫学的・臨床的情報の多くは議論の余地がある。方法：軍の医療センター7施設で精巣腫瘍を有する黒人66例を後方視的に検討した。結果：黒人の精巣腫瘍は、予後、左右差、非セミノーマおよび間質性腫瘍の発症年齢について一般の精巣がん集団と同様の結果を示した。黒人では間質性腫瘍がわずかに多いが、セミノーマと非セミノーマの分布は一般集団と類似していた。セミノーマの平均発症年齢は一般の精巣がん集団より若かった。同一施設で治療された精巣腫瘍について、黒人では白人に比べて診断の遅延が増加していた。1979年から1991年の間に、ある主要施設における新規精巣がん症例数は白人では増加したが、黒人では増加しなかった。シスプラチンを基盤とした併用化学療法の利用が可能になったことで、白人集団と同様に黒人の予後が改善した。結論：黒人の精巣腫瘍は、間質性腫瘍がより多く、セミノーマの平均発症年齢がより若いことを除けば、一般集団の精巣腫瘍と同様に振る舞う。黒人では白人に比べ診断の遅延が増えているが、この集団での発生率は増加していないようである。シスプラチン併用化学療法は、この集団の生存率を大きく改善した。
